title: Bank of Baroda (BOB) Recruitment 2026 – Local Bank Officer LBO Posts
shortInfo: Bank of Baroda (BOB) has announced notification for Local Bank Officer LBO posts. Required qualification: Graduation in any discipline, 1 year experience. Last date to apply: 07-09-26.

fees.fee: Rs. 850/- (Inclusive of GST) + Payment Gateway Charges

fees.category: SC / ST / PwBD / Ex-Servicemen (ESM/DESM) / Women candidates
fees.fee: Rs. 175/- (Inclusive of GST) + Payment Gateway Charges

dates.event: Last Date for Submission of Application & Payment of Fees

howToApply: Visit Bank’s official website www.bankofbaroda.bank.in under Career section → Current Opportunities.
Register online in the appropriate Online Application Format available through the link on the Careers → Current Opportunities page.
Upload scanned photograph, signature, bio-data, and other required documents as per specifications.
Carefully fill in all details in the online application form. No changes are permitted after clicking SUBMIT.
Pay the application fee online using Debit Card / Credit Card / Internet Banking / UPI etc.
On successful payment, an e-receipt and application form will be generated — print and retain for future reference.
Note down the acknowledgement number and keep a copy of the application form for future reference.
Download call letters from the Bank’s website under Career section → Current Opportunities using registration details and password.

title: Mizoram PSC Recruitment 2026 – Assistant Sub-Inspector (Ministerial) Posts
shortInfo: Mizoram PSC has announced notification for Assistant Sub-Inspector (Ministerial) posts. Required qualification: Bachelor's degree. Last date to apply: 07-09-26.
howToApply: Visit the Mizoram Public Service Commission’s official online portal at https://mpsconline.mizoram.gov.in.
If not already registered, complete the One-Time Registration (OTR) on the portal before applying.
Log in and fill out the application form for the post of Assistant Sub-Inspector (Ministerial).

Upload all mandatory documents including: Marksheets of HSLC and above, Educational Certificates of HSLC and above, Proof of Computer Proficiency, Proof of Mizo Language Proficiency, SC/ST Certificate (if applicable), Proof of date of birth, and Proof of educational qualifications.
Pay the application fee through the available payment modes (UPI must be done using the mobile number used for OTR registration).
Verify that the application is actually submitted after payment is made.
Submit the application before 07.09.2026 up to 4:00 PM.
Government servants must apply through proper channel.
